title: Research: wp11_ks_sign/decrypt return generic -1 for all errors
description: wp11_ks_sign and wp11_ks_decrypt in wp11_backend_keystore.c return -1 for ALL error conditions, including buffer-too-small. The WP11_BACKEND_ERR_* codes defined in wp11_backend.h include distinct values for different failure modes, but none of these are returned by the keystore backend — it just returns -1 (WP11_BACKEND_ERR_GENERAL). Investigate: (1) Are there callers outside wp11_pkcs11.c that rely on distinct error codes from these functions? (2) Does C_Sign in wp11_pkcs11.c fully gate buffer size before calling the backend (via sig_len_max), making the missing WP11_BACKEND_ERR_BUFFER_SMALL irrelevant? (3) Is C_Decrypt similarly protected? If the C_* layer always validates size first, the generic -1 is acceptable but should be documented. If there is any path where a buffer-too-small reaches the backend, we need a distinct error code and proper CKR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL mapping.
